resources.string: Shown while the library server is running.
The library server is not running. Open the settings to start it.
Allow other devices on this network
Off: only apps on this phone can connect (127.0.0.1). On: devices on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot can connect too.

Copy .cbz files or manga folders into the library folder above, e.g. over USB (it shows as Android/data/app.mokuro.bunko/files/… on the phone\'s storage). Uploading through Mokuro Reader or the web UI works too. Uninstalling the app deletes this folder unless you choose to keep the app\'s data.
On this phone, add a WebDAV server in Mokuro Reader with the URL:
From other devices on this network:
Turn on \"Allow other devices\" to read from other devices.

Browsers block an https:// page (reader.mokuro.app) from reaching a plain http:// address other than 127.0.0.1. For other devices, use a Mokuro Reader app, enable HTTPS in the admin panel, or use the tunnel.
Android may stop background apps to save battery. Exempt Mokuro Bunko from battery optimisation so the server keeps running with the screen off.
Battery optimisation: optimised — the server may be stopped in the background
Notifications are off: Android hides the server\'s status, but it still runs.
